name: Bulk SEO Importer (Lite)
author: Roger Blumen

sections.description:
Bulk SEO Importer (Lite) streamlines SEO operations at scale by importing and exporting key fields via CSV:

post_id (required)

slug (optional)

url (read-only export)

seo_title (optional)

meta_description (optional)

It auto-detects the active SEO plugin and writes to the correct meta keys for Yoast, Rank Math, and AIOSEO. The exported url column provides a clear, read-only permalink for each post, making it easier than ever to identify content in your spreadsheet.

More features are available in the Pro version, including additional fields (canonical URL, focus keyword, social tags), custom post types, bulk image SEO, and support for multilingual sites (WPML & Polylang). Learn more: https://bulkseoimporter.com/pro

Features (Lite)

CSV Import of seo_title, meta_description, and slug by post_id.

CSV Export (Lite) with post_id, slug, url, seo_title, and meta_description.

SEO Plugin Detection: Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO meta keys handled automatically.

Secure, validated, and sanitized processing.
sections.faq:
Does it require an SEO plugin?

No. It works without one, writing to generic meta keys if no supported plugin is active.

Can I import only one field?

Yes. Include only the columns you want to change; others are ignored.

Does it support multilingual sites?

The Lite version exports your content as-is. The Pro version adds a dedicated language_code column for easy filtering and management with WPML and Polylang.

Does it support custom post types?

The Lite version focuses on posts and pages. Pro adds CPT support.
